title: Orsen and the Passage
author: Tamsin Pemberton
blurb: Isandro Iversen, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
